description: Star-rating distribution, average and share of 1–2 star reviews for one app in one storefront, plus a day-by-day curve (count and average per day) and a per-version breakdown — so a drop lines up with the release that caused it. Defaults to the last 90 days.

country.description: country code, e.g. tr, us (defaults to the app's first country)

name: get_review_stats
